address: 137 Eldridge St., New York, NY, 10002, USA
bio: Busy, cramped, and bursting with personality, this Vietnamese-inspired bistro from Chefs Sadie Mae Burns and Anthony Ha is the place to be. Getting in requires planning: Arrive before doors open to join the waitlist. Such is the reality of this rambunctious hotspot where Vietnamese and French ideas swirl about on a single plate. Think leeks vinaigrette with marinated mussels, fried whiting with tamarind powder, or a dazzling, celebratory, vol-au-vent loaded with pristine seafood flecked with fiery chilis. There’s plenty to drink too: A surprisingly lengthy list of natural wines tempts, but have you ever tried a fish sauce martini or a shiso margarita bolstered with lemongrass liqueur? There’s a first time for everything.
